from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperInfo(BaseModel):
    """An extraction from a single provided paper containing its title and the titles of other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper, as identified in the document")
    referenced_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of papers referenced in this document's bibliography that correspond to the set of provided papers")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperInfo]
